method.design: full-cluster census (no sampling): all 235 unique SYNPATH+VAULTX items judged once each
method.denominator_note: 235 unique items = 209 SYNPATH + 28 VAULTX − 2 dual-cluster items (INT-0052 Spatial Distance Bias, INT-0202 Vector-Jacobian Products) counted once; the plan's '237' arithmetic double-counted them (F-0049)
method.carry_over: 6 items with prior canonical judgments (INT-0031/0032/0046/0047 from MEDNLP, INT-0187/0192 from 2D3D) carried over verbatim with carry_over_from provenance per the one-item-one-judgment rule (F-0048)
method.groups: 17 bounded subagent groups (max 18 items; grouped by cluster+section, sections never merged)
method.judges: 17 independent general-purpose subagents reading destination notes and grepping the vault for surface forms + alternative terminology before any absent verdict (chemistry/equivariance/RL terminology hints added to the S34 judging instructions)
method.depth_standard: campaign plan section 5 (what it is / why it exists / how it works conceptually / relations to other concepts; project usage not required for 'covered')
method.evidence_rule: covered/equivalent/partial require a verbatim quote (>= 12 words for covered/equivalent) mechanically validated as a whitespace-normalized substring of the cited note (scripts/s34_validate_judgments.py, exit 0: 235/235 PASSED)

orchestrator_rereview.method: stratified even-spaced sample (every 8th record of the 235 = 30 items, 12.8%) plus 3 added equivalent-verdict items (the trickiest class) = 33 items (14.0%): 20 absent verified by independent orchestrator greps over all 544 notes of the item names, the judges' search terms, and orchestrator-chosen alternatives (all 544-note scans: PaiNN/SchNet/GemNet/EGNN/synthon/retrosynthesis/torsion/dihedral/chemoselectiv*/deprotect*/resonance/heavy-atom/drug-like/Lipinski/QED/ligand/SE(3)/conformer/stereochem*/SMILES/invariant-point all 0 occurrences; every nonzero hit independently read and confirmed a false positive: 'receptor' = retinal photoreceptors, 'graph neural' x3 = bare name-drops in other contexts, 'message passing' x2 = multi-agent homonym, 'e(3)' x2 = np.eye(3)/range(3) code); 6 covered + 3 equivalent verified by reading the cited destination notes and judging verdict + quote depth against the campaign depth standard; 4 partial verified by reading the cited sections and confirming the below-depth-but-present characterization
orchestrator_rereview.notes: Sample spans all 14 sections and all 4 verdict classes. Notable confirmed judgment calls: INT-0033 QKV covered (dedicated Queries Keys and Values note: database analogy, matrix form, three roles); INT-0041 Softmax Attention covered (dedicated Scaled Dot-Product Attention note + Linear Attention baseline framing + MiniMax-01 hybrid analysis — consistent with the prior MEDNLP judgment of INT-0031, the same underlying mechanism); INT-0209 Checkpoint Recovery covered via the capstone's dedicated Sharded-checkpointing + Recovery-from-failures sections; INT-0053 Distance-Based Attention Bias EQUIVALENT via ALiBi (full-depth additive score bias by distance); INT-0103 Conditional Probability Factorization EQUIVALENT via the chain-rule-of-probability treatment (formula + LM training + generation connections); INT-0207 Gradient Stability EQUIVALENT via the gradient-flow concept in Vanishing and Exploding Gradients. All 20 sampled absent verdicts confirmed: the molecular-chemistry / geometric-RL vocabulary has zero genuine vault occurrences.

limitations: single-judge-per-item design mitigated by mandatory multi-term search before absent verdicts + the 14.0% orchestrator re-review; borderline covered/partial calls carry uncertainty noted by judges
judgments reflect the vault as of session 33 state (no vault mutations occurred during judging)
'covered' does not include project usage; project context integration happens in the S37+ execution waves
